text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference.  One original fictional adult man. East Asian man with voluminous dark-brown center-part hair, composed urban charm, simple black leather jacket and white shirt with slim black tie. Facial design: shorter oval face with a broad rounded jaw, expressive arched brows, slightly wide-set narrow monolid eyes, softly convex medium nose, small full lips, light beige skin. Black leather zip-front jacket over white shirt and slim black tie, straight black tailored trousers, black leather boots. Lean 186cm build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
